chunks: And with this chain of narrators, it was said that the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said:
One who delivers a letter of a warrior is like one who frees a slave, and he shares in the reward of that military expedition.

key_terms.غَازٍ: warrior or one who participates in jihad

ai.seo_question: What is the reward for delivering a message for a warrior in Islam?
ai.summary: Shaykh al-Saduq records this hadith to emphasize that logistical support in jihad carries the same spiritual weight as direct combat, specifically noting the messenger shares in the reward of that particular campaign. This reflects the Shia scholarly view that the 'just Imam' ensures equitable distribution of merit among all participants, whether on the front lines or handling communications. The comparison to freeing a slave underscores the high status of this service in the hierarchy of good deeds.

en.sayed-athar-husain-rizvi-&-sayed-maqs: One who takes a letter of a warrior to its destination, will be like one who has freed a slave and will get the reward of participating in that Jihad.”
